1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi babwirisha inanga ijwi ryitwa Mahalati. Ni indirimbo ya Dawidi yahimbishijwe ubwenge.

2.text: Umupfapfa ajya yibwira ati “Nta Mana iriho.”Bononekaye bakiraniwe ibyo kwangwa urunuka,Nta wukora ibyiza.

3.text: Imana yarebye abantu iri mu ijuru,Kugira ngo imenye yuko harimo abanyabwenge bashaka Imana.

4.text: Bose basubiye inyuma,Bose bandurijwe hamwe,Nta wukora ibyiza n'umwe.

5.text: Mbese inkozi z'ibibi nta bwenge zifite,Ko barya abantu banjye nk'uko barya umutsima,Kandi ntibambaze Imana?

6.text: Aho ngaho bahagiriye ubwoba bwinshi ari nta mpamvu,Kuko Imana yashandaje amagufwa y'uwagerereje ngo agutere,Wabakojeje isoni kuko Imana yabasuzuguye.

7.text: Icyampa agakiza k'Abisirayeli kakaba kavuye i Siyoni,Imana nisubizayo ubwoko bwayo bwajyanywe ho iminyago,Ni bwo Abayakobo bazishima,Abisirayeli bazanezerwa.
